backend/main.mo: Motoko backend implementing access‑controlled user profiles, story submission, comments, and admin moderation and publishing.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing updated warm‑palette image assets and affected frontend files.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of major frontend components, hooks, and styles.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining a warm editorial OKLCH color palette for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router routes for feed, submit, story detail, and admin pages using AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedStat: UI card shown when a user lacks admin permissions, with navigation back to the feed.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Sticky header with warm‑palette wordmark and navigation buttons for stories and submission.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Global page layout with header, main content region, and footer.
Form component allowing users to submit comments using mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/CommentThread.ts: Fetches and displays a story’s comments with loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor using identity, refreshing queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Admin hooks for fetching all submitted stories and publishing rewritten stories.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Defines a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling login, stored identity restoration, and status flags. Includes a hook for accessing identity state and initiating login or clear actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useStories.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching published stories, fetching a single story, submitting stories, and adding comments via the backend actor. Uses mutations to update cached data after submissions or comments.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining a light and dark editorial theme with custom CSS variables and typography enhancements. Applies global styles, focus states, and prose formatting for story content.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app by wrapping it in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, then rendering the root component. Imports global styles and initializes the query client.
frontend/src/pages/AdminModerationPage.t: Displays an admin interface for reviewing submitted stories, editing content, and publishing them. Handles authorization errors, loading states, and publishing mutations with UI feedback.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Shows a feed of published stories with a hero section, loading skeletons, error handling, and navigation to story detail pages. Fetches published stories using React Query.
frontend/src/pages/StoryDetailPage.tsx: Renders a single story’s details along with comments and a comment composer. Handles loading and error states using data fetched from useGetPublishedStory.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitStoryPage.tsx: React page providing a story submission form with optional anonymity, validation, and a post-submit confirmation screen.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based parameter cleanup.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, color tokens, fonts, animations, and plugin setup for the frontend.
project_state.json: Project state file describing platform features, requirements, known issues, and image recolor fix instructions.
